project.art_direction: Source-matched detailed naturalistic pixel-art. Retain the exact master individual and painted material.
project.session_goal: A true top projection suitable for depth estimation.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1536x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: wood_top_locked
asset.description: The exact same forked driftwood from the reference viewed in STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP PLAN. Camera points VERTICALLY DOWN, elevation EXACTLY 90 degrees. Reveal the entire FRONT-BACK spread of stabilizing roots and the upper sides of the knotted root crotch. Tall upward fork must be strongly foreshortened into a short stub extending toward camera rather than towering above the main trunk. Keep master left-right orientation with knotted base LEFT and long sinuous main limb reaching RIGHT. This object is about twice as long as its front-back spread. Preserve source branch inventory and continuous natural grain. This must be a real camera rotation, not a copied broadside pose. White studio background, entire silhouette and margins, no scene, text or cast shadow.

plan.prompt:
Subject: Single forked driftwood branch, knotted root base at LEFT, long sinuous main limb reaching RIGHT; strict top-down rotation of the same master piece, roots spreading front-to-back, upper sides of the knotted root crotch visible, upward fork foreshortened into a short stub pointing toward camera; continuous natural grain, identical branch inventory.
Silhouette: Readable elongated fork, overall length about twice its front-back spread, clean unbroken outline, generous even margins, centered.
Style lock: Soft style alignment with art direction; prefer cohesive look over literal copy.; Source-matched detailed naturalistic pixel-art: painted wood grain, muted brown and tan palette, consistent fine line weight, master material preserved, no invented detail.
View: Top-down view, looking straight down, clear readable shapes from above; Strict orthographic top plan; camera pointing vertically down at exactly 90 degrees elevation; master left-right orientation retained, no broadside or oblique copy.
Technical: Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), uniform studio backdrop; single object centered; mattable still; no environment scenery; Pure flat white #FFFFFF studio backdrop, entire silhouette inside frame, no ground shadow, no scene, 3:2 landscape.
Negatives: No spritesheet; no multiple action frames in one image; never transparent background or checkerboard; No oblique, three-quarter, side or broadside view; no towering upright fork; no transparent or checkerboard background; no scenery, text, UI, cast shadow, extra or duplicated branches.
negative_hints: Do not prompt for transparent background or checkerboard.
Do not include multiple characters or action frames.
Do not include borders, frames, vignettes, gradients, or textured backdrops.
Character sprite only — not a prison scene, not environmental background, not item icon.
No prison walls, bars, cells, floors, or scenery behind the character.
